translations.Postponedでの同時刻更新の集約、非選択要素と選択変更、コンテナ置換、mo: The following features are added to Postponed: concentration of simultaneous updates, changes of non-selected elements and selections, container replacement, output stop after monitoroff and close, and leakage prevention to reopen destination.

translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のように終わりの決まる指令の後の要素を捨てる実装では e が: An implementation that discards elements after a directive with a defined endpoint, such as ZXQPH0QXZ, leaves e undeclared and causes an error (ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ).
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のイベント制御付きトリガを、発行元の終了後にも観測します。: The event-controlled trigger of ZXQPH0QXZ is observed even after the issuer has been terminated.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のガードがないヘッダは ZXQPH1QXZ 回目の読み込みで: Headers without guards of ZXQPH0QXZ redefining ZXQPH2QXZ to ZXQPH3QXZ on the ZXQPH1QXZ read, line ZXQPH4QXZ does not match the expected output.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のクロックの有無を検査しない処理系は受理して失敗する。: Processing systems that do not check the presence of the clock of ZXQPH0QXZ will accept and fail.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のチャネル割当や ZXQPH1QXZ の戻り値・対象が規格と: If the channel allocation of ZXQPH0QXZ or the return value or object of ZXQPH1QXZ is not in accordance with the specification, the line "one channel each..." or "...close of both returned ZXQPH2QXZ" will change or the file will be unreadable.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のデータ型・暗黙型（範囲 ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2Q: Implementations that do not handle either the data type of ZXQPH0QXZ or the implicit type (range ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ ZXQPH3QXZ) or type format fail to compile, and if the implicit range is ignored, bits(ZXQPH4QXZ)=ZXQPH5QXZ will change to ZXQPH6QXZ, if ZXQPH7QXZ is not linked to ZXQPH8QXZ bits(ZXQPH9QXZ) will change, and if ZXQPH10QXZ is not computed from the N after parameter overwriting, ZXQPH11QXZ = ZXQPH12QXZ will change.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のネット r には ZXQPH1QXZ つの継続代入を与え(: Give the net r of ZXQPH0QXZ a ZXQPH1QXZ continuum assignment (line ZXQPH2QXZ is the ZXQPH3QXZ one), a declaration of r (line ZXQPH4QXZ), a ZXQPH5QXZ driver (line ZXQPH6QXZ), and an error in either of the ZXQPH7QXZ drivers.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のネットワークは、 ZXQPH1QXZ の強 ZXQPH2Q: The network of ZXQPH0QXZ is stronger than ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ and weaker than ZXQPH3QXZ ZXQPH4QXZ to ZXQPH5QXZ..
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のハンドル、派生クラス ZXQPH1QXZ のハンドル、nu: The handle of ZXQPH0QXZ, the handle of the derived class ZXQPH1QXZ, and the write by null are the standard-accepted contrasts, and the control version displays ZXQPH3QXZ ZXQPH4QXZ ZXQPH5QXZ in ZXQPH2QXZ.

translations.ZXQPH0QXZ のメッセージを ZXQPH1QXZ 変数で取ると負になること: The message of ZXQPH0QXZ is taken as a ZXQPH1QXZ variable, and the non‐equivalent integer type is distinguished by the negative result.

translations.シーケンスのイベント制御をマッチ終点ではなく開始時点で起動する誤実装なら @ Z: If the sequence's event control is incorrectly implemented to start at the start of the match rather than at the end, @ ZXQPH0QXZ will resume at ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ will change to ZXQPH4QXZ.

In seed ZXQPH0QXZ and degrees of freedom ZXQPH1QXZ, the chi-powered ZXQPH2QXZ sample ZXQPH3QXZ is obtained ZXQPH4QXZ times, the square root ZXQPH5QXZ and the following regular sample ZXQPH6QXZ are obtained ZXQPH7QXZ times, and the result is ZXQPH8QXZ.

translations.スコープの timescale を読まずに固定値を返す実装では ZXQPH0QX: In an implementation that returns a fixed value without reading the timescale of the scope, ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ are the same value, and in an implementation that return a simulation time unit (minimum accuracy ZXQPH3QXZ = ZXQPH4QXZ) other than ZXQPH2QXZ, the ZXQPH5QXZ side is not ZXQPH6QXZ.
translations.スコープの単位で換算しない実装（例えば常に ZXQPH0QXZ や ZXQPH1: In implementations that do not convert to scope units (e.g. always ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ), the real of b becomes ZXQPH2QXZ or ZXQPH3QXZ, in implementations that do not look at type, the real remains ZXQPH4QXZ (ZXQPH5QXZ ZXQPH6QXZ is the case), if ZXQPH7QXZ is not treated as a simulation time unit, ZXQPH8QXZ etc. becomes a different value, and if the high/low division is wrong, the row in ZXQPH9QXZ changes.
translations.スコープの型や変数の型に他のキーワード（ ZXQPH0QXZ 状態 ZXQPH1: Implementations that use other keywords (e.g. ZXQPH0QXZ state ZXQPH1QXZ of ZXQPH2QXZ / ZXQPH3QXZ) for the type of the scope or the type of the variable change the line in every scope / var.
translations.スコープの時間単位で換算しない実装では ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QX: In an implementation that does not convert the scope to time units, ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ are the same value (the real value of the ps unit), while in an implementation that ignores type, real remains the initial value ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.スコープを無視して全体の値を返す実装では b の行が ZXQPH0QXZ / Z: In an implementation that ignores the scope and returns the total value, the row of b will be ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ etc. (ZXQPH2QXZ ZXQPH3QXZ ignores the scope for precision and returns ZXQPH4QXZ in units), while in an implementation that returns the maximum unit or the unit of the first module in ZXQPH5QXZ the value of null scope will be other than ZXQPH6QXZ (ZXQPH7QXZ ZXQPH8QXZ is ZXQPH9QXZ), and the unit/precision line in.expected will change.
translations.スコープ付きの別名や resolver なしの形式を受け付けない実装ではコンパイ: Implementations that do not accept aliases with scope or without resolver fail to compile, and implementations that do not inherit the original resolver function from the alias do not make ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.スコープ付きの解決関数名を受け付けない実装ではコンパイルが失敗し、名前を別の関数: In implementations that do not accept solver function names with scope, compilation fails and the values of ZXQPH0QXZ = or real ZXQPH1QXZ = change when resolving the name to another function.
translations.スコープ探索優先・スカラ幅・既定ネット型が、それぞれ別の出力行に現れる。: The scope search priority, scale width, and default net type appear in separate output lines.
translations.スコープ解決接頭辞は下方だけを向き、通常のスコープ規則で見つかる接頭辞はクラスと: The scope-solving prefixes are only downward-oriented, and the prefixes found in the normal scope rules are solved as classes.
translations.ステップの失敗で ZXQPH0QXZ を呼ばない実装では ZXQPH1QXZ の: In implementations that do not call ZXQPH0QXZ for step failure, the line of step failure in ZXQPH1QXZ is deleted.
translations.ステップの照合した式を渡さない、または失敗したステップで失敗した式を最後に置かな: In an implementation that does not pass the matching expression of the step, or does not put the failed expression at the end of the failed step, ZXQPH0QXZ is other than a/b/c (e.g. none).
translations.ステップを本体の前に実行する誤実装では ZXQPH0QXZ が ZXQPH1QX: In the do-while misperformance, the decision is placed after the body, and ZXQPH0QXZ is ZXQPH1QXZ..., while ZXQPH2QXZ is ZXQPH3QXZ instead of ZXQPH4QXZ..., and i is changed.
translations.ステップ実行を有効にしていない ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ の試: The ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ attempts that do not have step execution enabled also fail, but the step callback is not produced.
translations.ストリーミングの並べ替えと格納先の状態型変換: Stream interchange and state transformation of the storage
translations.ストリーミング演算子の位置でのアクセス可否を検査せず local メンバも並べる: A incorrect implementation that does not check accessibility at the location of the streaming operator and also includes the local member will accept the ZXQPH0QXZ line and fail.
translations.ストリーミング連結を右辺とする展開まで拒否する実装は ZXQPH0QXZ 行目で: An implementation that rejects streaming links until the right-edge is expanded will return an error on line ZXQPH0QXZ, which does not match the specified line.
translations.ストリーミング連結を通常の整数のオペランドとして受け付ける誤実装は ZXQPH0: A incorrect implementation that accepts streaming links as ordinary integer operands fails to accept the ZXQPH0QXZ line.
translations.ストリームを右側ゼロ詰めして宛先の型へ暗黙変換することを観測する。: We observe that the stream is implicitly converted to the destination type by packing the right side of the stream with zeros.
translations.ストリームを右詰めして上位をゼロ拡張する誤実装なら data が ZXQPH0Q: If the stream is right-packed and the top-zero is expanded, data becomes ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ becomes ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ストリームを数値として real へ暗黙に変換する誤実装は ZXQPH0QXZ: Mis-implementations that implicitly convert streams to real as numerical values fail by accepting the ZXQPH0QXZ line (ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ is accepted).
translations.ストリームを通常の整数代入と同様に右詰め（上位ゼロ拡張）する誤実装なら resu: If the stream is mis-implemented to be right-filled (extended to the top zero) as in normal integer assignment, the result will be ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ will be changed to ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ストリームを連結してから slice 単位で並べ替えない実装、または入れ子の内側: In implementations where streams are linked and then not rearranged by slice units, or where the inside of the insert is not rearranged first, ZXQPH0QXZ is a separate value.
translations.スライスの境界は定数です。: The boundary of the slice is a constant.
translations.スライスの範囲や連結の順序を誤る誤実装では ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1: In the case of a incorrect implementation that mis-orders the range of slices or the sequence of connections, ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ = ZXQPH3QXZ are changed to a different bit array, and ZXQPH4QXZ = ZXQPH5QXZ is changed in the case of a mis‐implementation that writes the output slice to the whole.
translations.スライス外のアドレスを受け入れる実装は設計を受け付け、 ZXQPH0QXZ 行目: Implementations that accept addresses outside the slice accept the design and do not issue the ZXQPH0QXZ line error.
translations.スライス幅は正の定数。: The slice width is a positive constant.
translations.スレッドやオブジェクトの ZXQPH0QXZ を手動 seed できない実装では: In an implementation that cannot manually seed ZXQPH0QXZ of a thread or object, the reproduction of the same seed breaks down, and in an implementation that does not propagate the seed of the root to its offspring, ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ do not match.
translations.スレッド間で v を共有する誤実装では ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ: In the case of a incorrect implementation that shares v between threads, the result is ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ, etc.

translations.モジュール内での同じプログラムのインスタンスは規格で認められる対照で、それを拒否: An instance of the same program inside a module is a standard-permitted control; an implementation rejecting it reports line ZXQPH0QXZ and therefore does not match.
translations.モジュール内での同じモジュールのインスタンスは規格で認められる対照で、モジュール: An instance of the same module inside a module is a standard-permitted control; an implementation rejecting module instantiation generally also reports a different line and therefore does not match.
translations.モジュール内で局所 ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ の宣言前に読む: In a module, we compare in one line the following: ZXQPH2QXZ = ZXQPH3QXZ read before the declaration of local ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ and read after ZXQPH4QXZ = ZXQPH5QXZ, ZXQPH6QXZ = ZXQPH7QXZ read before the declarations of wildcard import lp::* and read after ZXQPH8QXZ = ZXQPH9QXZ, ZXQPH10QXZ = ZXQPH11QXZ after import, and f()=ZXQPH13QXZ call before the local function f declared at the end of the module (returns ZXQPH12QXZ).
translations.モジュール内と実体側の両方で ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ 、 Z: The comparison of ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ = ZXQPH3QXZ is done both in the module and on the body side.
translations.モジュール内の ZXQPH0QXZ インスタンスは規格で認められる対照で、そこを: The ZXQPH0QXZ instance in the module is a specified contrast, and the implementation that rejects it is reported on a separate line.
translations.モジュール内の import 宣言を受け付けない、または import した名前: Mis-implementations that do not accept import declarations in the module, or do not make the imported name appear in the module's scope, cannot be compiled and do not output.
translations.モジュール内の specify ブロックを受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできない: Mis-implementations that do not accept specify blocks in the module cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール内のインタフェース宣言を受理しない、あるいはそれをインスタンス化できな: Compilation fails in the case of a incorrect implementation that does not accept interface declarations in the module, or cannot instantiate them.
translations.モジュール内のクラス宣言を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできず出力がない。: Mis-implementations that do not accept class declarations within the module cannot be compiled and do not output.
translations.モジュール内のサブルーチン定義を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできない。: Mis-implementations that do not accept the subroutine definitions in the module cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール内のネット・変数・構造体・共用体の宣言を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイル: Mis-implementations that do not accept declarations of nets, variables, structures, and commons within the module cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール内のプログラム宣言を受理しなければコンパイルに失敗し、暗黙のインスタン: Compilation fails if the program declaration in the module is not accepted, and the prog line is not output unless the implicit instance is created.
translations.モジュール内のモジュール宣言を受理しなければコンパイルに失敗する。: Compilation fails if module declarations within the module are not accepted.
translations.モジュール内の利用者定義型を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできない。: Mis-implementations that do not accept user-defined types in the module cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール内の同じインタフェースのインスタンスは規格で認められる対照で、そこでエ: Instances of the same interface within the module are the standardized contrasts, and therefore do not match, so the incorrect implementation that causes the error is reported in a separate line (the ZXQPH0QXZ line).
translations.モジュール内の定数宣言を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできず、 ZXQPH0QX: Mis-implementations that do not accept constant declarations in the module cannot be compiled, do not calculate ZXQPH0QXZ from other constants, and do not set the initial value of const, and will change ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ or ZXQPH3QXZ = ZXQPH4QXZ.
translations.モジュール内の生成ブロックを受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできない。: Mis-implementations that do not accept the generation blocks within the module cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール内の連続代入を受け付けない誤実装はコンパイルできず、連続代入を評価しな: Mis-implementations that do not accept sequence assignments within the module cannot be compiled, and incorrect implementations that don't evaluate sequence assignments or follow changes to the right-edge will change the assign line to ZXQPH0QXZ instead of ZXQPH1QXZ, such as x.
translations.モジュール内の関数だけを定数関数呼び出しとして扱う誤実装では、パッケージ・ ZX: In the incorrect implementation that treats only functions within the module as constant function calls, the ZXQPH1QXZ line of the static method of the package ZXQPH0QXZ class cannot be compiled.
translations.モジュール外の ZXQPH0QXZ まで拒む実装は ZXQPH1QXZ 行目で報: An implementation that also rejects ZXQPH0QXZ outside the module reports line ZXQPH1QXZ and fails if there is no error on line ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.モジュール本体の ZXQPH0QXZ を宣言前に参照することを許す誤実装（ ZX: A incorrect implementation that allows reference to ZXQPH0QXZ of the module body before declaration (both ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ ZXQPH4QXZ are accepted by displaying ZXQPH5QXZ) fails the test.
translations.モジュール直下に同じ本体で宣言した g を呼ぶ ZXQPH0QXZ = g( Z: The ZXQPH0QXZ = g(ZXQPH1QXZ ) call of g declared in the same body directly below the module is a standardized contrast.
translations.モジュール直下の変数mem n r re s の ZXQPH0QXZ 個（配列m: The variables mem n r re s are ZXQPH0QXZ (the array mem is ZXQPH1QXZ) directly below the module, and do not include net w, named event e, parameter P, internal scope (blk, g) and interface bus variables.
translations.モジュール経由の disable で全モジュールの呼び出しを止める誤実装は時刻: A incorrect implementation of the module-by-module disable to stop calling all modules returns to ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.モジュール自体は全ネットを宣言した規格で認められる記述で、他に誤りはない。: The module itself is a description accepted by the standard declaring the whole net, and there is no other error.
translations.モジュール自身の変数 own の階層名参照( ZXQPH0QXZ 行目)も規格で: The hierarchical name reference of the own variable of the module itself (ZXQPH0QXZ line) is also placed as a contrast that is accepted by the standard.
translations.モジュール項目としてのインタフェースインスタンスを受理しなければコンパイルに失敗: Compilation fails if an interface instance is not accepted as a module item, and ZXQPH0QXZ cannot be resolved and ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ is not output if an instance is not created.
translations.モジュール項目としてのプログラムインスタンスを受理しなければコンパイルに失敗する: Compilation fails if the program instance is not accepted as a module item.
translations.モジュール項目の static ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ = ZX: static ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ for module items;

translations.モードポートのクロッキングブロック名を他のインタフェース（設計中の同名のクロッキ: Mis-implementation of the mode port's clock block name from another interface (clock block of the same name in the design) fails the negative test without diagnosis on line ZXQPH0QXZ.
translations.ユーザメッセージを出さない、書式を処理せず生の文字列を出す、最初の引数しか使わな: In implementations that do not output a user message, that output a raw string without processing the format, that use only the first argument, the test fails if parts like ZXQPH0QXZ do not match.
translations.ユーザー bin があると自動 bin を全て除く誤実装なら keep の分母が: If there is a user bin, the denominator of keep is ZXQPH0QXZ if the incorrect implementation is all except the auto bin.
translations.ユーザー bin と重なる積の自動 bin まで残す実装なら分母が ZXQPH0: If the implementation leaves the user bin to the auto bin of the overlapping product, the denominator is ZXQPH0QXZ.
translations.ユーザー systf の呼び出し引数が ZXQPH0QXZ アプリへ渡らず読めな: In implementations where the call arguments of the user systf cannot be read without passing ZXQPH0QXZ to the application, the value line of ZXQPH1QXZ does not match the expected output because it either changes or does not appear.
translations.ユーザーデータを import 関数ごとに分ける実装では ZXQPH0QXZ が: In an implementation that separates user data by import function, ZXQPH0QXZ becomes ZXQPH1QXZ, and in an implementation that does not distinguish keys, the value of the shared key is changed to ZXQPH2QXZ by put of the own key.
translations.ユーザーデータ領域をスコープ間で共有する実装では ZXQPH0QXZ の ZXQ: In an implementation that shares the user data region between scopes, ZXQPH1QXZ of ZXQPH0QXZ reads ZXQPH2QXZ, and ZXQPH3QXZ of ZXQPH4QXZ reads ZXQPH5QXZ.
translations.ユーザ定義 nettype のネットに force できない実装ではエラーになり: If the user-defined nettype is not implemented in a way that can force the net, it will fail, and if the implementation does not re-evaluate the solver function after release, the ZXQPH0QXZ line will be ZXQPH1QXZ or ZXQPH2QXZ before force.
translations.ユーザ定義 nettype のネットにも組み込みネットの z を与える実装では: In an implementation that also embeds the z of the net into the net of the user-defined nettype, ZXQPH0QXZ =zzzz, and in an implementation that does not use the default value of the data type, ZXQPH1QXZ is not ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ユーザ定義 nettype のネットをビットごとに解決する実装では ZXQPH0: An implementation resolving a user-defined nettype net bit by bit makes ZXQPH0QXZ a bitwise result without a carry such as ZXQPH1QXZ; it instead gives ZXQPH3QXZ 1, for example, like ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ユーザ定義 nettype の宣言で遅延を無視する実装では ZXQPH0QXZ: In an implementation that ignores the delay in the declaration of the user-defined nettype, ZXQPH2QXZ of ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ becomes ZXQPH3QXZ, and an implementation that does not declare the ZXQPH4QXZ net in the list fails to compile.
translations.ユーザ定義の ZXQPH0QXZ 修飾子にも ZXQPH1QXZ * を立てる実: In an implementation that also uses ZXQPH1QXZ * for the user-defined ZXQPH0QXZ modifier, the ending will be undef until the application's ZXQPH2QXZ / ZXQPH3QXZ and lines ZXQPH4QXZ and ZXQPH5QXZ will be ZXQPH6QXZ.
translations.ユーザ定義の定数関数を評価して受理する誤実装は ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQP: The misconception that the user-defined constant function is evaluated and accepted is ZXQPH0QXZ = ZXQPH1QXZ, and the negative test fails without error on line ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ユーザ定義ネット型にも組込みベクトルネットと同じく立上り・立下りの複数遅延を許す: The incorrect implementation that allows multiple up and down delays in the user-defined net type, like the embedded vector net, fails to accept the ZXQPH0QXZ line.
translations.ユーザ定義ネット型のネットの一部（メンバ）への連続代入を許す誤実装は ZXQPH: A incorrect implementation that allows a continuous assignment to a part (member) of a user-defined net type will fail to accept the ZXQPH0QXZ line.
translations.ユーザ定義ネット型のネットへの連続代入自体を拒否する実装は対照の行でエラーを出し: An implementation that rejects the continuous assignment itself into a user-defined net type net will give an error on the opposite line and will not match the specified line.
translations.ユーザ定義ネット型への遅延自体や組込みネットの ZXQPH0QXZ 遅延を拒否す: Implementations that reject the delay itself to the user-defined net type or the ZXQPH0QXZ delay of the embedded net will error on the opposite line and will not match the specified line.
translations.ユーティリティ ZXQPH0QXZ が ZXQPH1QXZ のビット ZXQPH: The utility ZXQPH0QXZ returns ZXQPH3QXZ (x)/ZXQPH4QXZ (z) on the ZXQPH2QXZ bit of ZXQPH1QXZ, ZXQPH5QXZ returns ZXQPH8QXZ on the ZXQPH7QXZ bit of ZXQPH6QXZ, and the output ZXQPH11QXZ ZXQPH12QXZ ZXQPH13QXZ ZXQPH14QXZ on the ZXQPH15QXZ side is ZXQPH16QXZ 11xx, where C writes aval ZXQPH9QXZ bval ZXQPH10QXZ.
translations.ライブラリ付きcellとliblistの組合せを通常のliblist句として受理: A incorrect implementation that accepts a combination of cell and liblist with a library as a normal liblist statement does not return an error on line ZXQPH0QXZ and fails the negative test.
translations.ライブラリ名を付けない（ ZXQPH0QXZ ）、空や ZXQPH1QXZ を返: In the case of an incorrect implementation, such as not naming the library (ZXQPH0QXZ), returning empty or ZXQPH1QXZ, or returning an external config name even under the hierarchical config, the ZXQPH2QXZ in the u/v line and the ZXQPH4QXZ in the ZXQPH3QXZ line will change.
translations.ライブラリ省略時に親セルの library を継承せず束縛を無視する実装では Z: In an implementation that ignores constraints without inheriting the parent cell's library when omitting a library, ZXQPH0QXZ =aa, ZXQPH1QXZ =cc, and in an implementation that does not allow constraints where the module name of the instance and the target cell name are different, bb/dd is not obtained, so the expected output is different.
translations.ライブ値、別エッジのclockingサンプル、cbをクロックとするasserti: The live value, the clocking sample of the different edge, and the failure time of the assertion with cb as the clock are distinguished.
translations.ラベルで名前付きブロックを作らない誤実装( ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QX: In the case of a incorrect implementation (ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ is one) where no named blocks are created in the label, %m of each action will be ZXQPH2QXZ or... ZXQPH3QXZ, and lines ZXQPH4QXZ to ZXQPH5QXZ and ZXQPH6QXZ will be changed.
translations.ラベルで暗黙ブロックとは別のブロックを作る誤実装では %m が ZXQPH0QX: In the case of a incorrect implementation where the label creates a block separate from the implied block, %m will be ZXQPH0QXZ (ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ).
translations.ラベルで暗黙ブロックの外に別ブロックを作る誤実装では %m が ZXQPH0QX: In the case of a incorrect implementation where a label creates a block outside of the implied block, %m will be ZXQPH0QXZ (ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ).
translations.ラベルなしの単一変数 ZXQPH0QXZ に変数名を付けない、またはラベルを名前: Mis-implementations that do not name a single unlabeled variable ZXQPH0QXZ, or do not use a label as a name, either fail to compile a reference to ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQPH2QXZ or return another entry, and the line "n ZXQPH3QXZ, lab ZXQPH4QXZ" changes.
translations.ラベルのブロックを assertion の後まで広げる誤実装では next st: In the incorrect implementation that extends the label block to after the assertion, the next statement line changes to … ZXQPH0QXZ etc.
translations.ラベルを wait fork に持たせない誤実装は『label ZXQPH0QX: If the label is not in the wait fork, the label ZXQPH0QXZ is changed to ZXQPH1QXZ, and if the label is not in, the name is changed to ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ラベルを返さない誤実装は label ZXQPH0QXZ に、ラベルなしで非 Z: Mis-implementations that do not return a label are named in label ZXQPH0QXZ, while incorrect implementations that return non-labels and ZXQPH1QXZ are named in line ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.ラベル付きの文を disable できない（あるいは文の後へ進まずプロセスごと終: In the implementation where labelled statements cannot be disabled (or end process-by-process instead of moving after the statement), over at ZXQPH0QXZ = becomes ZXQPH1QXZ or ZXQPH2QXZ and n/m moves to the end of the loop, to ZXQPH3QXZ = ZXQPH4QXZ or ZXQPH5QXZ = ZXQPH6QXZ.
translations.リストにない ZXQPH0QXZ - ZXQPH1QXZ x の ZXQPH2Q: ZXQPH2QXZ for unlisted ZXQPH0QXZ-ZXQPH1QXZ x does not cause a switch.
translations.リストの ZXQPH0QXZ つ目以降の割り当てを無視する実装では Q が既定の: In an implementation that ignores the allocations after ZXQPH0QXZ in the list, Q remains the default ZXQPH1QXZ and becomes ZXQPH2QXZ = ZXQPH3QXZ, while ignoring ZXQPH4QXZ itself becomes ZXQPH5QXZ = ZXQPH6QXZ and ZXQPH7QXZ = ZXQPH8QXZ.
translations.リストの ZXQPH0QXZ 番目の gj が内側ループの添字として働き row: The ZXQPH0QXZ gj in the list acts as the inner loop's index row ZXQPH1QXZ ZXQPH2QXZ ZXQPH3QXZ.col ZXQPH4QXZ ZXQPH5QXZ ZXQPH6QXZ.
translations.リストの ZXQPH0QXZ 番目の名前を ZXQPH1QXZ として宣言しなけ: If the ZXQPH0QXZ name in the list is not declared as ZXQPH1QXZ, the loop of gj cannot be created, and if it is identified with gi, the distinction of ZXQPH2QXZ = ZXQPH3QXZ is lost.

translations.単一initialで別名取得、プロパティ更新、package更新、ハンドル再束縛: One initial process successively creates aliases, updates properties and packages, rebinds a handle, updates the retained alias, advances the outer package and independent object, and recovers known values.

translations.継承、static、浅いコピーnew handle、null、並行呼出し、時間制: Inheritance, static methods, shallow-copy construction, null handles, concurrent calls, timing controls, ZXQPH0QXZ, mixed signedness and direct imports in class scope are outside this model.

translations.function/taskの入出力変換、呼出し順序、外部更新後の再呼出し、隣接要: Observe function/task input/output conversions, call order, calls after external updates, and retention of neighbors and other scopes.
