translations.二つの派生オブジェクトを使い、直呼び・基底ハンドルのvirtual/非virtu: Two derived objects distinguish direct calls from virtual and nonvirtual base-handle calls.
translations.ifと通常caseはX/Z条件を偽側へ送り、条件演算子は各ビットをマージする。: If and ordinary case take the false/default path for X/Z conditions; the conditional operator merges each bit.
translations.既知値の相と既知値またはX/Z入力の相を実行し、 ZXQPH0QXZ 型でも条件: Run a known-input phase and a known/X/Z phase; keep the selector ZXQPH1QXZ even for ZXQPH0QXZ data.
translations.返す値を取得してから同じreceiverのdataだけを更新し、早期return: Capture the returned value before updating only the receiver data; statements after the early return must not execute.
translations.各呼出し後に両オブジェクトと保持した別名、幅を広げた結果、呼出し数を観測する。: After each call observe both objects, a retained alias, wider result variables and invocation counts.
translations.外部更新、別ハンドルへの再束縛、guardだけの更新、反復呼出しと最終保持を確認: Check external updates, handle rebinding, guard-only writes, repeated calls and final retention.
translations.単一initial、時間を消費しないfunctionのみ。: Use one initial process and functions that consume no time.
translations.再帰・ref・null・並行性・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・プロパティの隠蔽・sup: Recursion, ref, null, concurrency, ZXQPH0QXZ, property hiding, super and mixed-sign arithmetic are outside scope.
translations.クラスの直呼びと基底ハンドル経由の呼出しで条件選択・更新先・早期returnを照: Compare conditional selection, update targets and early returns through direct class calls and base handles.
translations.if/caseと条件演算子のX/Z、型付き結果の符号拡張、別名と再束縛後のオブジ: Observe X/Z behavior of if/case and conditional expressions, typed-result sign extension, retained aliases and object independence after rebinding.
translations.receiverごとの値を条件演算子と ZXQPH0QXZ で評価し、既知・X/: Evaluate receiver-owned values with conditional expressions and ZXQPH0QXZ; compare known/X/Z selection and typed-return sign extension against the other object.
translations.クラスメソッドのifまたはcaseによる早期returnが選択した値とrecei: Check that early returns selected by class-method if/case update only the selected value and receiver, without post-return effects or writes to the other object.
translations.割合の分母は要求台帳の行で、テスト本数ではありません。: The denominator counts requirement-ledger rows, not test files.
translations.各行は独立した保存実行です。: Each row is a separate saved run.
translations.小範囲の実行で未実行が多い場合もあるため、 ZXQPH0QXZ と計測元を確認し: A narrow run can leave many tests unexecuted; check ZXQPH0QXZ and the measurement source.
translations.日時・版・対象範囲の読み方: how to read dates, versions and scope
translations.要求行の対応と ZXQPH0QXZ の証拠を数えています。: This counts requirement mappings and evidence of ZXQPH0QXZ.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ を読み、テスト本数や一つのツールの一致率と区別してください。: Read ZXQPH0QXZ to distinguish these metrics from test counts or one tool’s match rate.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ 因子 ZXQPH1QXZ で何を判断できるかは ZXQPH2: See ZXQPH2QXZ for what ZXQPH1QXZ of ZXQPH0QXZ-factor coverage establishes, and ZXQPH4QXZ for the difference between the plan and actual ZXQPH3QXZ.
translations.全行が合法で未対応による除外なし。: All rows are legal; no support-based exclusions are applied.
translations.二moduleインスタンスの各二生成要素が独立した ZXQPH0QXZ プロセス: Two module instances each contain two generated elements with independent ZXQPH0QXZ processes, local types, arrays and counters.
translations.分岐と ZXQPH0QXZ で局所幅・配列範囲が変わる。: Branches and ZXQPH0QXZ determine local widths and array ranges.
translations.for/while/repeatは同じ論理位置順に走査し、最下位ビットの!==: For/while/repeat scan the same logical positions, using low-bit case inequality against ZXQPH0QXZ for break/continue.
translations.while/repeatは分岐前に添字を進めるため、continueでも停止性を: While/repeat advance the index before branching, so continue cannot prevent termination.
translations.head/middle/tailは奇数スコープで反転し、回復相では一つ回す。: Head/middle/tail positions reverse in odd scopes and rotate once in the recovery phase.
translations.長さ一の位置の重複も保持する。: Equivalent positions at length one are retained.
translations.既知・既知またはX/Z・既知への回復の各相で二回起動し、その間に一スコープの入力: Each known, known/X/Z and known-recovery phase triggers twice, changing one scope input and another scope guard between triggers.
translations.クロックを下げた後と待機中も保持を読む。: Check retention after falling edges and during idle.
translations.符号付き演算・foreach・動的配列・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・名前付きdisa: Signed arithmetic, foreach, dynamic arrays, ZXQPH0QXZ, named disable, concurrent writers and variable hierarchy indices are outside scope.
translations.X/Z入力では ZXQPH0QXZ 格納への変換でもfourstateを指定する: X/Z inputs retain fourstate metadata even when converted into ZXQPH0QXZ storage.
translations.生成プロセスごとの配列走査とbreak/continueを、訪問数・保持数・重み: Check each generated process’s array scan and break/continue with visited/kept counts, weights and full-width results.
translations.一スコープの入力変更、別guardの更新、立上りでの再起動、立下りと待機中の状態: Observe one scope’s input change, a separate guard update, rising-edge rearming and state retention after falling edges and during idle.
translations.生成スコープの独立したループでbreak/continueの移動先と反復の継続を: Check transfer destinations and iteration continuation in independent generated loops using array scans, visit counts, weights and full-width results.
translations.生成された各 ZXQPH0QXZ プロセスの局所状態と再起動を、入力変更直後・次: Check each generated ZXQPH0QXZ process’s local state and rearming immediately after input changes, at the next rising edge, after falling edges and during idle.
translations.生成要素ごとの配列幅・負や非零の添字範囲を実際の問い合わせと全要素の表示で観測し: Observe per-element widths and negative/nonzero array bounds through actual queries and every element; retain other scopes’ arrays after updating one element.
translations.二interfaceは幅・長さ・添字原点・向きが異なる。: The two interfaces have different widths, lengths, index origins and directions.
translations.一番目は幅Wと長さ ZXQPH0QXZ 、二番目は幅W+ ZXQPH1QXZ と: The first has width W and length ZXQPH0QXZ; the second has width W+ZXQPH1QXZ and length ZXQPH2QXZ with the opposite direction.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ 範囲も逆向きで原点付き。: The ZXQPH0QXZ ranges also have opposite directions and nonzero origins.
translations.interface内のautomatic function/taskが ZXQP: An automatic function/task inside the interface uses ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQPH2QXZ to scan logical positions, computing an order-sensitive full-width checksum with left shifts and ZXQPH3QXZ.
translations.省略した次元と明示次元 ZXQPH0QXZ を区別し、 ZXQPH1QXZ 次元: Distinguish omitted dimensions from explicit dimension ZXQPH0QXZ and observe every query on ZXQPH1QXZ dimension ZXQPH2QXZ as well.
translations.既知・既知またはX/Z・既知への回復の三相で、各呼出し後に両実体を読む。: In known, known/X/Z and known-recovery phases, observe both instances after every call.
translations.一方の末尾要素と他方のguardだけを更新し、逆順で再呼出しする。: Update only one last element and the other guard, then call again in reverse order.
translations.戻り値とoutputコピーは幅W+ ZXQPH0QXZ の ZXQPH1QXZ: Store returns and output copyout into width-W+ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ results.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ へのX/Z変換もfourstateを指定する。: X/Z conversion into ZXQPH0QXZ also retains fourstate metadata.
translations.符号付き演算・interfaceポート・modport・virtual inte: Signed arithmetic, interface ports, modports, virtual interfaces, dynamic arrays, concurrent calls and timing controls are outside scope.
translations.interface内の配列問い合わせが走査の開始位置・回数・方向と型付き結果を決: Interface-local array queries determine the scan start, count, direction and typed result.
translations.全要素・両次元の境界・単一要素・別実体の保持・入力変更後の再呼出しを照合する。: Check every element, both dimension bounds, singletons, independent-instance retention and repeated calls after input changes.
translations.interfaceごとの固定配列の幅・添字範囲・全要素を観測し、一方の要素更新と: Observe each interface’s fixed-array width, bounds and every element; distinguish and retain one element update and a separate guard update.
translations.interface内の ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQP: Interface-local ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQPH2QXZ determine the actual scan order and count; check both dimension query tuples and the typed result.
translations.automatic functionの戻り値とtaskのoutputコピーを、局: Check automatic function returns and task output copyout against a full-width checksum computed using local array queries and fresh per-call local variables.
translations.二moduleの ZXQPH0QXZ は ZXQPH1QXZ で、定数Aは最上位: The two modules use ZXQPH0QXZ values ZXQPH1QXZ; constant A has only its high bit set to ZXQPH2QXZ or value ZXQPH3QXZ, while every bit of B is ZXQPH4QXZ.
translations.両オペランドの幅は基底幅で独立に符号を選ぶ。: Both operands have the base width and independently chosen signedness.
translations.加算・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・条件演算子の結果は基底幅または一つ広い型付き ZX: Store the addition, ZXQPH0QXZ or conditional result in a typed ZXQPH1QXZ of the base width or one bit wider.
translations.式は両オペランドがsignedのときだけ符号拡張し、結果の宣言符号とは区別する。: Sign-extend the expression only when both operands are signed, independently of the result declaration’s signedness.
translations.格納後の負判定がif/case generateを選び、最上位と最下位のビットが: The stored negative test selects if/case generate; high and low bits determine a generated count from ZXQPH0QXZ to ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の剰余が生成幅を決め、 ZXQPH1QXZ でさらに幅を変え: The remainder of ZXQPH0QXZ determines generated width, which ZXQPH1QXZ varies further.
translations.各要素は独立したraw・guard・連続代入結果を持つ。: Every element has independent raw, guard and continuous-assignment result words.
translations.既知・既知またはX/Z・既知への回復の三相で全要素を読み、一方の先頭入力と他方の: Observe every element in known, known/X/Z and known-recovery phases, updating only one first input and the other instance’s last guard.
translations.X/Zは実行時刺激だけに使い、定数式とgenerate条件は既知値。: Use X/Z only in runtime stimulus; constant expressions and generate conditions remain known.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ への変換でもfourstateを指定する。: Conversion into ZXQPH0QXZ also retains fourstate metadata.
translations.config・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・未定義の階層参照・動的な生成添字・符号付き: Configuration, ZXQPH0QXZ, undefined hierarchy references, dynamic generate indices and signed runtime arithmetic are outside scope.
translations.定数式のオペランド符号・代入文脈の幅・結果の宣言符号を分離し、生成分岐・個数・幅: Separate constant-expression operand signs, assignment-context width and result declaration sign; check generated branches, counts and widths.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ による形状、各生成要素の全幅データ、別実体の保持、X/Zと既: Observe ZXQPH0QXZ-driven shape, full-width data in each generated element, independent-instance retention and X/Z followed by known recovery.
translations.定数式の幅・オペランドの共通符号・格納後の負判定が、generateの選択と反復: Check how constant-expression width, common operand sign and the stored negative test change generate selection/count through actual hierarchy and full-width observations.
translations.型付き定数に対する ZXQPH0QXZ を生成幅の計算に使い、文脈幅の変更を実際: Use ZXQPH0QXZ on a typed constant to compute generated width, propagating context-width changes into actual element widths and full-width observations.
translations.wholeでは使わないplacementをlowに代表させる。: Use low as the representative placement when whole-target scans do not use that factor.
translations.他の全行は合法で未対応による除外なし。: All remaining rows are legal; no support-based exclusions are applied.
translations.二つの出力幅はWとW+ ZXQPH0QXZ 、格納語の幅はW+ ZXQPH1QX: The two destination widths are W and W+ZXQPH0QXZ; guarded storage words have width W+ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.部分選択は低位または高位へ置き、+:と-:を区別する。: Place part-selects in low or high positions and distinguish +: from -:.
translations.書式の先頭フィールド幅は対象または格納語の ZXQPH0QXZ から作り、最大文: Derive the first format field width from ZXQPH0QXZ of the target or guarded word and use it as the maximum character count.
translations.hexでは文字数とビット数は異なる。: For hexadecimal fields, character count differs from bit count.
translations.literalでは同じ幅を生成時に埋め、runtimeでは実際の書式変数を渡す。: Literal formats embed the same width at generation time; runtime calls pass the actual format variable.
translations.先頭成功後の文字不一致、第二変換の不一致、空入力、全成功を区別する。: Distinguish a literal mismatch after the first success, second-conversion failure, empty input and complete success.
translations.成功した変換だけが書き込み、後続出力と選択範囲外を保持する。: Only successful conversions write; retain later destinations and unselected bits.
translations.既知・既知またはX/Z・既知への回復の各相で試行と全成功の再呼出しを行い、履歴を: In known, known/X/Z and known-recovery phases, make a trial and a fully successful followup while retaining history.
translations.X/Zは既知 ZXQPH0QXZ の数字として入力し、 ZXQPH1QXZ 格納: Supply X/Z as known ZXQPH0QXZ digits and retain fourstate metadata even for conversion into ZXQPH1QXZ storage.
translations.可変の選択添字・変換抑制・空白の特殊規則・実数・ファイルI/O・並行実行は対象外: Variable select indices, suppressed conversions, special whitespace rules, reals, file I/O and concurrency are outside scope.
translations.文字列の読取りが途中で止まる位置と成功した書込みだけを、戻り値・全語・部分選択外: Check scan stopping and successful writes through return counts, full words and retention outside part-selects.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ を使う実行時書式、文字数としてのフィールド幅、既知 ZXQP: Observe runtime formats using ZXQPH0QXZ, character-count field widths, known ZXQPH1QXZ X/Z digits and destination conversion.
translations.走査の成功位置ごとに+:または-:の選択領域だけを書き換え、後続出力と両側の非選: At each successful scan conversion, update only the +: or -: selected region and check later outputs and both sides of unselected storage through full words.
translations.対象または格納語の ZXQPH0QXZ を実際の書式変数の最大文字数に使い、その: Use ZXQPH0QXZ of the target or storage word as the actual format variable’s maximum character count; check boundary conversion counts and partial writes.
translations.二つの独立programが各二つのautomatic task呼出しを重ねる。: Two independent programs each overlap two automatic task calls.
translations.開始は ZXQPH0QXZ 、復帰は ZXQPH1QXZ 、外部入力と実引数の更: Calls start at ZXQPH0QXZ, return at ZXQPH1QXZ, and external inputs and actuals change at ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.対象programだけを ZXQPH0QXZ または ZXQPH1QXZ で Z: Apply ZXQPH2QXZ only to the target program at ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ, retaining a natural-completion control.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の仮引数と局所語は呼出しごとに保持し、正常なendtaskま: Keep ZXQPH0QXZ formals and local words private to each call; copy out only on normal endtask or return.
translations.実引数は ZXQPH0QXZ ビット広い ZXQPH1QXZ で、符号拡張と固定: Actuals are ZXQPH0QXZ-bit-wider ZXQPH1QXZ words; observe sign extension and unselected elements of fixed arrays [ZXQPH2QXZ].
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ で既知値に更新し、生存するprogramが同じtaskを再呼: Reset to known values at ZXQPH0QXZ; surviving programs call the same task again and return at ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.監視はmoduleだけで行い、programの書込みと同時刻の観測順序に依存しな: Only the module observes output, avoiding observation-order dependence at program write times.
translations.相手programのinitialは ZXQPH0QXZ まで待ち、module: The counterpart program initial waits until ZXQPH0QXZ; the module finishes explicitly at ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.暗黙の全体終了は主対象にしない。: Implicit global completion is outside the main scope.
translations.ref・可変添字・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・再帰・同時刻の: Ref arguments, variable indices, ZXQPH0QXZ, ZXQPH1QXZ, recursion, concurrent same-tick writers and static tasks are outside the main scope.
translations.入力X/Zから ZXQPH0QXZ への変換でもfourstateを指定する。: Retain fourstate metadata even when input X/Z converts into ZXQPH0QXZ.
translations.重なるautomatic taskの局所値と ZXQPH0QXZ のコピーを、p: Check overlapping automatic task locals and ZXQPH0QXZ copying across program termination scope and return methods.
translations.途中終了時のコピー抑止、生存する別program、符号拡張、配列の隣接要素と再呼: Observe suppressed copies on cancellation, the surviving peer program, sign extension, neighboring array elements and recall history.
translations.重なるautomatic taskの仮引数と局所値を保持し、正常復帰だけが ZX: Check private formals/locals of overlapping automatic tasks and normal-return-only ZXQPH0QXZ copying across target-program termination and peer survival.
translations.taskの早期returnは出力を戻して呼出し元へ復帰する一方、programの: Distinguish early task return with copyout and caller continuation from program ZXQPH0QXZ cancellation through later statements, actuals and return counts.
translations.二packageの同名固定配列は幅・長さ・添字原点・向きが異なる。: Two packages contain same-named fixed arrays with different widths, lengths, origins and directions.
translations.各moduleには幅も長さも異なる同名のローカル配列を置く。: Each module also has a local namesake array with a different width and length.
translations.automatic function内の明示import・ワイルドカードimpo: An explicit import, wildcard import or qualified reference inside an automatic function selects the target package.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQPH2QXZ が走査の開始: ZXQPH0QXZ / ZXQPH1QXZ / ZXQPH2QXZ determine scan start, count and direction; left shifts and ZXQPH3QXZ accumulate every bit.
translations.省略次元と明示次元 ZXQPH0QXZ 、 ZXQPH1QXZ 次元 ZXQPH: Observe omitted and explicit dimension ZXQPH0QXZ, ZXQPH1QXZ dimension ZXQPH2QXZ, and ZXQPH3QXZ / ZXQPH4QXZ / ZXQPH5QXZ.
translations.既知・既知またはX/Z・既知への回復の三相で、二つの呼出し元と以前の結果を保持す: Retain two callers and previous results across known, known/X/Z and known-recovery phases.
translations.非選択packageの更新後も再呼出しし、次に選択packageと両module: Call again after updating the unselected package, then update only the selected package and both modules’ local arrays.
translations.全配列要素・型付き結果・呼出し回数・訪問数・重み・終端添字を各操作後に観測する。: After each operation observe every array element, typed results, calls, visits, weighted indices and terminal indices.
translations.export・動的配列・符号付き演算・task・時間制御・並行呼出しは対象外。: Export, dynamic arrays, signed arithmetic, tasks, timing and concurrent calls are outside scope.
translations.関数内のimportと修飾参照が配列問い合わせの対象を決め、開始位置・回数・方向: Function-local imports and qualified references select query operands, determining scan start, count, direction and full-width accumulation.
translations.非選択packageと同名ローカル配列の更新後も、対象配列の型・全要素・履歴を保: Check target array types, every element and history after updating the unselected package and local namesakes.
translations.関数内の明示・ワイルドカードimportまたは修飾参照が、配列問い合わせの幅・境: Explicit/wildcard imports or qualified references inside functions determine array-query widths, bounds and directions; check the resulting full-width scan accumulation and call history.
translations.全 ZXQPH0QXZ 行のうちallで使わないpivotをmiddleに代表さ: Represent the unused pivot by middle in all rows: remove ZXQPH1QXZ duplicates from ZXQPH0QXZ Cartesian rows, leaving ZXQPH2QXZ legal rows.
translations.静的な二つの名前付きイベントを使い、イベント値のコピーや再結合は行わない。: Use two static named events without copying or rebinding event values.
translations.対象は時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ 、対照は ZXQPH1QXZ で発火する。: Trigger the target at ZXQPH0QXZ and the control at ZXQPH1QXZ.
translations.lateでは最初の発火文の後に ZXQPH0QXZ で待機者を作り、親の時間待ち: For late rows, create the waiter with ZXQPH0QXZ after the first trigger statement; the parent’s timed suspension starts it in the same tick.
translations.@待機は過去の発火を保持せず、triggered待機は同じタイムスロットの発火を: An edge wait does not retain past triggers; a triggered wait detects a trigger in the same time slot.
translations.四回までのforループで一回だけcontinueまたはbreakし、再待機前には: A bounded four-iteration for loop continues or breaks once, advancing ZXQPH0QXZ tick before rearming.
translations.各発火の ZXQPH0QXZ tick後に観測し、子プロセスの再待機と同時刻の観: Observe ZXQPH0QXZ ticks after each trigger, avoiding same-tick observation and child rearming.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ で残る子を終了し、 ZXQPH1QXZ で新しい待機者を作り: Cancel remaining children at ZXQPH0QXZ, create fresh waiters at ZXQPH1QXZ, and check known recovery inputs at ZXQPH2QXZ.
translations.全保存語・受信時刻・保持マスク・集計値・回数を保持し、 ZXQPH0QXZ への: Retain every saved word, receive time, retention mask, accumulator and count, displaying X/Z before conversion into ZXQPH0QXZ too.
translations.動的イベント・null・ref・遅延付き発火・同時発火・ ZXQPH0QXZ は: Dynamic events, null, ref, delayed triggers, simultaneous triggers and ZXQPH0QXZ are outside scope.
translations.名前付きイベントを読むforループでbreak/continueと待機開始順を交: Cross break/continue with registration order in event-consuming for loops, checking receive and retention history.
translations.同じタイムスロットのtriggeredとエッジ待機、 ZXQPH0QXZ 発火、: Observe same-slot triggered versus edge waiting, ZXQPH0QXZ dispatch, independent events and rearming after cancellation.
translations.continueは次のイベント待機へ進み、breakは受信ループを終了することを: Cross waiting mode, registration order and dispatch region to distinguish continue advancing to the next event wait from break leaving the consumer loop through captured words, receive times, retention masks and counts.
translations.taskの遅延の時間スコープを宣言・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ: Set the time scope of a task delay by a declaration, ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ or nesting, and add settings that must lose.
translations.遅延の換算と精度への丸めを、 ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・$: Compare the scaling and rounding of the delay with the caller's scope through reads of ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , $ ZXQPH2QXZ and %t.
translations.packageは入れ子にできないのでnestedとの組合せだけ除外する。: Only the nested rows of a package are excluded, because packages cannot nest.
translations.遅延を持つtaskの時間スコープを、宣言・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1: The time scope of a task with a delay comes from a declaration, ZXQPH0QXZ , the timeunit of ZXQPH1QXZ or inheritance by nesting.
translations.効かないはずの ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ のtimeunitを: A ZXQPH0QXZ and a timeunit of ZXQPH1QXZ that must lose turn a precedence error into different output.
translations.呼出し元は別の時間単位を持ち、同じ数値の遅延でも経過時間が変わる。: The caller has another time unit, so the same number waits a different time.
translations.値は精度の桁で切下げ・二進で正確な同点・切上げ・端数なしを選ぶ。: Values round down, tie exactly in binary, round up or need no rounding at the digit of the precision.
translations.コピーした ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・$ ZXQPH2QXZ: Reads of ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , $ ZXQPH2QXZ and %t are observed in both scopes after each step.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の同点と、 ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2QXZ ・p: Ties of ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , programs and class methods are outside the scope.
translations.基数・符号・桁数・先頭桁を変えたリテラルを、直接・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・マクロ: Carry literals of varied base, sign, digit count and leading digit directly, by a ZXQPH0QXZ , by macro tokens and by a continuous assignment.
translations.左への詰めと切り捨て、式の文脈による拡張、代入先の幅と ZXQPH0QXZ への: Observe every bit of the left padding and truncation, the extension by expression context, the target width and the conversion to ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.文法に合わない形（unbasedのs・サイズ、xやzを複数桁に含む ZXQPH0: Forms outside the grammar are excluded: an unbased literal with s or a size, and base ZXQPH0QXZ with x or z among several digits.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ビットを超える無サイズ数は幅が処理系依存なので、桁はすべて: An unsized number above ZXQPH0QXZ bits has an implementation-defined width, so all digits stay within ZXQPH1QXZ bits.
translations.先頭がxまたはzの無サイズ数の右シフトは、その幅が結果に現れるので除外する。: A right shift of an unsized number led by x or z is excluded, because its width shows in the result.
translations.先頭がxまたはzの符号なし無サイズ数は式の幅まで同じ値で広がる（ ZXQPH0Q: An unsized unsigned number led by x or z extends to the width of the expression with that value ( ZXQPH0QXZ , Example ZXQPH1QXZ ).
translations.同じリテラルをinitial内の直接の記述・型なし ZXQPH0QXZ ・三字句: The same literal is written directly in an initial procedure, held by an untyped ZXQPH0QXZ , expanded from three macro tokens and used in a continuous assignment.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ はリテラル自身の幅になるので、unbased unsized: A ZXQPH0QXZ takes the literal's own width, so an unbased unsized literal widens as ZXQPH1QXZ bit.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の代入先ではX/Zを ZXQPH1QXZ へ変換する。: A ZXQPH0QXZ target converts X and Z to ZXQPH1QXZ .
translations.continuous assignの網は ZXQPH0QXZ 値のまま観測する。: The net of a continuous assignment is observed with its ZXQPH0QXZ values.
translations.無サイズ数の ZXQPH0QXZ は「少なくとも ZXQPH1QXZ 」で値が定: The ZXQPH0QXZ of an unsized number is only at least ZXQPH1QXZ , so it is not observed.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ 個のゲートの配列へ昇順・降順のベクタ、部分選択、連結、スカラ: Connect ascending and descending vectors, part-selects, concatenations and scalars to an array of ZXQPH0QXZ gates, and check the bit mapping.
translations.既知値・X/Z・既知値の変化で、各出力の真理値表と立上り・立下り・ターンオフの遅: Through changes from known values to X or Z and back, read the truth table and the rise, fall and turn-off delay of each output at half times.
translations.notは第二入力を持たない。: A not gate has no second input.
translations.三つの遅延は ZXQPH0QXZ とnmosだけに許される。: Three delays are allowed only on ZXQPH0QXZ and nmos.
translations.端子の式は昇順・降順のベクタ、部分選択、連結、スカラで、幅が同じなら全インスタン: Terminals are ascending or descending vectors, part-selects, concatenations or scalars; one of the single-instance width is shared by all instances, and otherwise the instance of the right-hand index takes the ZXQPH0QXZ of the expression.
translations.入力は既知値から行のX/Zを含む値へ変え、再び既知値へ戻す。: Inputs go from known values to values with the X or Z of the row, then back to known values.
translations.変化の間隔は遅延より十分長く、出力の最後の値と遅延を規格の表から決める。: Changes are far apart compared with the delays, and the final output value and its delay come from the tables of the standard.
translations.読出しは遅延の時刻と重ならない半時刻で行い、全ビットを観測する。: Reads happen at half times, which no output event shares, and observe every bit.
translations.最初の遅延が終わる前の出力は規格が定めないので、第一段階は全出力が落ち着いてから: The standard does not define an output before its first delay ends, so the first phase is read after every output settles.
translations.遅延より短いパルスは第 ZXQPH0QXZ 章に規則がないので使わない。: Pulses shorter than a delay are not used, because Clause ZXQPH0QXZ has no rule for them.
translations.%vの強度はstrengthモデルに任せる。: The strengths of %v are left to the strength model.
translations.時間リテラルをスコープの単位へ換算して精度へ丸めることを、単位と同じ接尾辞と細か: Check that a time literal scales to the unit of the scope and rounds to its precision, with the suffix of the unit and with a finer suffix.
translations.手続き文の遅延がそのスコープの単位で換算され、一つずつ精度へ丸められて累積するこ: A procedural delay scales by the unit of its scope and accumulates after each delay rounds alone to the precision, compared with the same number in the caller.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の代入内遅延もtaskのスコープで換算され、更新で起きた後の: The intra-assignment delay of ZXQPH0QXZ also scales by the task's scope, and the time after the update wakes the task rounds as a statement delay does.
translations.実数の実引数は呼出し元ではなく遅延を実行するtaskのスコープで換算されることを: Reads in both scopes separate a real actual argument scaled by the task that runs the delay from one scaled by the caller.
translations.時間スコープが決める単位と精度を、 ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ: Compare the unit and precision set by the time scope with the caller's scope, through the rounding of ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ and the real read of $ ZXQPH2QXZ .
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の%tが、読出し値を呼び出したスコープの単位で解釈して同じf: Check with both ZXQPH1QXZ and $ ZXQPH2QXZ that %t of ZXQPH0QXZ reads the value by the unit of the calling scope and prints it in the same fs form.
translations.最後の ZXQPH0QXZ が ZXQPH1QXZ のtimeunitに優先し、: The scaling of delays shows that the last ZXQPH0QXZ wins over the timeunit of ZXQPH1QXZ and that a later ZXQPH2QXZ does not reach an earlier definition.
translations.入れ子のmoduleが、外側の ZXQPH0QXZ ではなく親のtimeunit: Delays and reads confirm that a nested module inherits the timeunit of its parent and not the ZXQPH0QXZ around it.
translations.interfaceのtaskの遅延がinterfaceの時間スコープで換算され、: Check that a task delay in an interface scales by the time scope of the interface and not by the unit of the calling module.
translations.packageのtaskの遅延と読出しがpackageの時間スコープを使い、im: Check that the delay and reads of a package task use the time scope of the package and not the unit of the caller that imports it.
translations.遅延付きゲートの出力が、入力の変化から立上り・立下り・ターンオフの表の時間の後に: Read at times no event shares that a gate output with a delay updates after the rise, fall or turn-off time of the table from the input change.
translations.リテラルのX/Zが ZXQPH0QXZ 値の代入先で ZXQPH1QXZ へ変わ: Observe that X and Z of a literal turn to ZXQPH1QXZ at a ZXQPH0QXZ -state target after the width extension.
translations.型なし ZXQPH0QXZ の型も同じ観測で確かめる。: The same observation checks the type of an untyped ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.continuous assignの網が同じリテラルの式の値を ZXQPH0QX: Observe, next to the procedural results, that the net of a continuous assignment takes the value of the same literal expression with its ZXQPH0QXZ values.
translations.リテラルの左詰めと符号を、加算・条件・単項マイナス・算術シフトの文脈が決める幅と: Check a literal's left padding and sign together with the extension by the width and sign that addition, conditional, unary minus and arithmetic shift contexts set.
translations.サイズ付きリテラルの ZXQPH0QXZ が、桁数によらず指定のサイズを返すこと: Check beside the truncation and padding of the value that ZXQPH0QXZ of a sized literal returns the given size for any digit count.
translations.サイズ・基数・桁の三字句をマクロで置いても、直接の記述と同じリテラルになることを: Check every bit that the size, base and digit tokens given by macros make the same literal as writing it directly.
translations.昇順・降順のパックド配列と部分選択を端子につないだときのインスタンスへのビットの: Check on every output bit how ascending and descending packed arrays and part-selects on terminals assign bits to instances.
translations.連結を出力端子につないだときの左右の順と、入力の値から決まる各インスタンスの出力: Check the left-to-right order of a concatenation on the output terminal and the output of each instance from its input values.
translations.インスタンスの配列の接続規則（同じ幅は共有、異なる幅は右端のインスタンスへ ZX: Check the connection rule of instance arrays (one width is shared, another puts the ZXQPH0QXZ on the instance of the right-hand index), crossing array direction with terminal forms.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ : チェッカの自由変数 v を assume で有効に保ち、: ZXQPH0QXZ : The checker keeps its free variable v active with an assume statement, records the current value at each tick and compares it with ZXQPH1QXZ (v) at the next tick.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ (v) のアサーションのアクションブロックは次のグローバルク: ZXQPH0QXZ (v) in an assertion runs its action block at the next global clock tick, where the pass action requires v to be ZXQPH1QXZ and the fail action requires v to be ZXQPH2QXZ .
translations.過去や未来の参照がそのティックの Postponed の値を取らないと、記録した: If a past or future reference does not take the Postponed value of its tick, it differs from the recorded or current value and mismatches is not ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.マクロの定義の形・本体の括弧・実引数を、 ZXQPH0QXZ の文脈とコンパイル: Cross the form of the macro definition, the parentheses of its body and the actual argument with ZXQPH0QXZ contexts and with where the definition sits in the compilation unit.
translations.文字として展開されるので、外側の演算子や優先順位の低い実引数の結合を値で確かめる: It expands as text, so the values show how an outer operator and a low-precedence argument bind.
translations.本体を括弧で囲む形・囲まない形・仮引数を二度使う形に、優先順位の低い実引数を置き: A low-precedence actual argument goes into a body with parentheses, a body without them or a body using the formal twice, and the values show how it binds with the outer operator.
translations.実引数の中のカンマは波括弧の中に置く。: A comma in an actual argument stays inside braces.
translations.変数・連続代入・assign・網・部分選択・wor・連結をforceし、その間と: Force a variable, a continuous assignment, assign, a net, a part-select, a wor net or a concatenation, and change the driver and the right-hand signal during and after it.
translations.各段階の値を ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2QXZ: Read the value of each step with ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , @ or a bit query function.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・@*・連続代入で読む式の形を変え、: Vary the form read by ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , @* and a continuous assignment, and write to parts that are read and parts that are not.
translations.再評価の回数と出力の値で、最長静的接頭辞と関数の中の読出しの扱いを確かめる。: The number of evaluations and the output values show how the longest static prefix and reads inside a function work.
translations.トークンの連結で作る識別子は単純な実引数だけ、文字列化で作る文字列は表示の文脈だ: An identifier built by token pasting takes only a simple argument, and a string built by stringification appears only where it is displayed.
translations.内側のマクロは外側の定義より後に定義し、使う時点の定義で展開されることを確かめる: The inner macro is defined after the outer one, to show that expansion uses the definition at the point of use.
translations.マクロの定義はコンパイル単位の先頭、別のモジュール、使う要素の中に置き、再定義・: A definition sits at the top of the compilation unit, in another module or in the element that uses it, or is chosen by redefinition, undef, elsif or ifndef.
translations.選ばれない枝には未定義のマクロと対応しないキーワードを置くが、字句としては正しく: A branch that is not chosen holds an undefined macro and an unmatched keyword, but stays lexically correct.
translations.__LINE__と__FILE__は別のテストに任せる。: __LINE__ and __FILE__ are left to other tests.
translations.左辺は変数、連続代入で駆動される変数、assignが有効な変数、網、網の部分選択: The left-hand side is a variable, a variable driven by a continuous assignment, a variable under assign, a net, a part-select of a net, a wor net with several drivers, or a concatenation of variables or of nets.
translations.変数のビット選択・部分選択は規格で禁じられているので使わない。: A bit-select or part-select of a variable is not used, because the standard forbids it.
translations.forceの間にドライバと右辺の信号を変え、releaseの後にもドライバを変え: The driver and the right-hand signal change during the force, and the driver changes again after the release.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ が最初の表示を行うかは規格が明示しないので、開始と同じ時刻に: The standard does not say whether ZXQPH0QXZ displays when it starts, so a value changes at that same time and a display is certain.
translations.@の観測は時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ の競合を避けて時刻 ZXQPH1QXZ 以降: An @ observer reports only from time ZXQPH1QXZ on, to avoid the race at time ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.release直後の読出しは、規格が即時と定める網と、変わらないと定める変数に限: A read right after a release is used only where the standard gives the result: a net, which changes at once, and a variable, which does not change.
translations.読出しは書込みと別の時刻に行う。: Reads happen at other times than writes.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ の評価は本体の ZXQPH2QXZ: Evaluations of ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ are counted by a ZXQPH2QXZ in the body, and the values of all forms are read at another time.
translations.@*と連続代入は再評価の回数が値に現れないので値だけを読む。: always @* and a continuous assignment show no count of evaluations, so only their values are read.
translations.初期値は宣言の初期化で与え、時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ の競合を避ける。: Initial values come from declaration initializers, to avoid races at time ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.関数の中で読む変数は ZXQPH0QXZ だけが感度に含み、@*と連続代入は実引: Only ZXQPH0QXZ includes what a function reads; always @* and a continuous assignment react only to its arguments.
translations.添字が変数の選択は最長静的接頭辞が配列全体なので、他の要素の変更でも再評価する。: With a variable index, the longest static prefix is the whole array, so a change to another element also reevaluates.
translations.releaseの後に網は直ちにドライバの値を持ち、連続代入のある変数は再評価で戻: After a release a net takes its drivers at once and a variable with a continuous assignment returns through a reevaluation, so the update differs by the kind of data.
translations.変数への連続代入と網の宣言代入で、オペランドの変化だけが左辺を更新することを確か: In a continuous assignment to a variable and a net declaration assignment, only a change of an operand updates the left-hand side.
translations.配列の要素や構造体のメンバへの更新が、最長静的接頭辞の重なる読み手だけを起こすこ: An update of an array element or structure member wakes only the readers whose longest static prefix overlaps it, as the number of evaluations shows.
translations.部分選択・条件演算子・連結のオペランドの更新で右辺を再評価し、読まない部分や同じ: An update of an operand of a part-select, conditional or concatenation reevaluates the right-hand side, and a write of an unread part or of the same value does not.
translations.構造体の代入パターンの要素でマクロを展開し、カンマを含む実引数とメンバの区切りを: Expand the macro in an element of a structure assignment pattern, and check that a comma in an actual argument is not taken for the separator of members.
translations.クラスの静的メソッドの本体でマクロを展開し、定義がクラスの外の位置からも届くこと: Expand the macro in the body of a static class method, and check that a definition reaches it from outside the class.
translations.forkの中の代入でマクロを展開する。: Expand the macro in an assignment inside a fork.
translations.forceした値を ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2: Read the forced value with ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ , to check values with X or Z and the width of a part-select.
translations.forceとreleaseの結果を ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ: Read the result of force and release with ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ , to check the value at the end of the time step and a display only when the value changes.
translations.連続代入の右辺でマクロを展開し、外側の演算子との結合を値で確かめる。: Expand the macro on the right of a continuous assignment, and check by value how it binds with the outer operator.
translations.本体と実引数が文字として置かれるので、優先順位の低い演算子の結合が展開の形で変わ: The body and the actual argument are placed as text, so check that low-precedence operators bind by the shape of the expansion.
translations.case項目の式でマクロを展開し、三項演算子のコロンと項目のコロンを混同しないこ: Expand the macro in a case item, and check that the colon of a conditional is not taken for the colon of the item.
translations.関数の本体でマクロを展開し、コンパイル単位の定義が関数の中でも使えることを確かめ: Expand the macro in a function body, and check that a definition of the compilation unit works there.
translations.定数の幅の式でマクロを展開し、 ZXQPH0QXZ で結果を確かめる。: Expand the macro in a constant width expression, and check the result with ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の引数でマクロを展開し、文字列化した実引数の置換も表示で確か: Expand the macro in an argument of ZXQPH0QXZ , and check by the display that a stringified actual argument is substituted.
translations.インタフェースの連続代入でマクロを展開し、インスタンスから値を読む。: Expand the macro in a continuous assignment of an interface, and read the value through the instance.
translations.パッケージのパラメータでマクロを展開し、定義がパッケージの外の位置からも届くこと: Expand the macro in a package parameter, and check that a definition reaches it from outside the package.
translations.生成ブロックの条件と中の定数でマクロを展開し、展開の結果でブロックの有無が決まる: Expand the macro in the condition of a generate block and in a constant inside it, and check that the expansion decides whether the block exists.
translations.符号付き ZXQPH0QXZ ・符号なし ZXQPH1QXZ ・符号付き ZXQ: Read a member that is signed ZXQPH0QXZ bits, unsigned ZXQPH1QXZ bits or signed ZXQPH2QXZ bits wide through a port, a modport, a generic port, an array element or a hierarchical name.
translations.除算・算術シフト・比較・単項マイナス・乗算と、文の制御・importしたtask: Check division, arithmetic shift, comparison, unary minus and multiplication, and the shared update through the control of statements and imported tasks.
translations.repeat・while・for・do・foreverの制御変数を、別プロセスが: Another process changes the control variable of repeat, while, for, do or forever by an ZXQPH0QXZ , after #ZXQPH1QXZ or at a later time.
translations.待ちのない本体・# ZXQPH0QXZ ・# ZXQPH1QXZ で、回数と Z: With a body that does not wait, waits #ZXQPH0QXZ or waits #ZXQPH1QXZ , check the count and the values that ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ and ZXQPH4QXZ show.
translations.x・zの詰め、?、下線、unbased unsized、符号、否定、エスケープを: Display literals with x or z padding, a question mark, underscores, unbased unsized forms, signs, negation and escapes in each format.
translations.自動の桁数・幅 ZXQPH0QXZ ・幅指定と、 ZXQPH1QXZ ・マクロ・: Check the automatic width, a width of ZXQPH0QXZ and a given width, carrying by ZXQPH1QXZ , a macro or a concatenation, and display tasks without a format.
translations.vは同じビット ZXQPH0QXZ （ ZXQPH1QXZ ビットはha）を符号: v holds the same bits ZXQPH0QXZ (ha for ZXQPH1QXZ bits), declared signed ZXQPH2QXZ bits, unsigned ZXQPH3QXZ bits or signed ZXQPH4QXZ bits, and is read through an interface port, a modport, a generic interface, an element of an array of interfaces or a hierarchical name.
translations.式の幅と符号は経路で変わらず、宣言の型と演算子の規則で決まる。: The width and sign of an expression do not change with the path; the declared type and the rules of the operators decide them.
translations.更新は直接代入・複合代入・modportでimportしたtask（引数で値を渡: A direct assignment, a compound assignment, a task the modport imports (taking the value as an argument) and a task computing the expression inside the interface give the same result.
translations.文の制御はインタフェースのnを経路から読み、更新のたびにnを ZXQPH0QXZ: The control of a statement reads n of the interface through the path, and every update decreases n by ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.repeatは回数を一度だけ評価する。: repeat evaluates its count only once.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ はインタフェースのポートを解析できないが: ZXQPH0QXZ ZXQPH1QXZ cannot parse interface ports, but no row is left out because a simulator does not support it.
translations.制御変数nは ZXQPH0QXZ から始まり、別のプロセスが時刻 ZXQPH1Q: The control variable n starts at ZXQPH0QXZ ; another process changes it to ZXQPH6QXZ by an ZXQPH2QXZ at time ZXQPH1QXZ , after #ZXQPH4QXZ at time ZXQPH3QXZ or at time ZXQPH5QXZ , or the loop body itself decreases it by ZXQPH7QXZ each time.
translations.本体はcountを増やし、待ちなし・# ZXQPH0QXZ ・# ZXQPH1Q: The body increments count and does not wait, waits #ZXQPH0QXZ or waits #ZXQPH1QXZ .
translations.# ZXQPH0QXZ で止まる本体と# ZXQPH1QXZ の後の書込みは同じ: A body waiting #ZXQPH0QXZ and a write after #ZXQPH1QXZ run in the same inactive region in either order, so that combination is left out.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ はタイムスロットの最後の値を表示し、: ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ show the values at the end of the time slot, and ZXQPH2QXZ shows the values at the call.
translations.時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ の競合を避けるため、両方のプロセスは# ZXQPH1Q: Both processes start with #ZXQPH1QXZ , to avoid races at time ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.リテラルの字句から幅・符号・各ビットを決め、%d・%h・%o・%b・%sと幅 Z: The text of the literal fixes its width, sign and every bit, and ZXQPH2QXZ line shows it in the %d, %h, %o, %b or %s format with a width of ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ or none.
translations.無サイズ数は少なくとも ZXQPH0QXZ ビットで全幅の桁数が定まらないので、: An unsized number has at least ZXQPH0QXZ bits, so its full width is not fixed, and it uses only a width of ZXQPH1QXZ or a given width.
translations.符号付きの値の%dの既定の桁数は読み方が分かれるので除外し、連結で符号なしになる: The default %d width of a signed value is read in two ways, so it is left out, except where a concatenation makes the value unsigned.
translations.%sは文字列リテラルだけに使う。: %s is used only with the string literal.
translations.書式のない ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2QXZ: ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ without a format appear only with the radix formats.
translations.書式のない引数の文字列リテラルは書式の文字列として表示される。: A string literal argument without a format is displayed as format text.
translations.連結は無サイズ数を含められないので、無サイズ数とunbased unsizedを: A concatenation cannot hold an unsized number, so the unsized number and the unbased unsized literal are left out of it.
translations.インタフェースのメンバの宣言の型が、ポート・modport・総称ポート・配列の要: Check that the declared type of an interface member decides the results of division, arithmetic shift, comparison, unary minus and multiplication, whether it is read through a port, a modport, a generic port, an array element or a hierarchical name.
translations.if・case・repeat・while・for・do・foreachの制御がイ: Check by the count and the final values that the control of if, case, repeat, while, for, do and foreach reads n of the interface through the path, and that every update decreases the shared value.
translations.modportでimportしたtaskへ値を渡す更新と、インタフェースの中で式: Check that an update passing the value to a task the modport imports, and an update by a task computing the expression inside the interface, give the same result as a direct assignment.
translations.ループの制御式を評価する時点と、別のプロセスの ZXQPH0QXZ ・# ZXQ: Check by the count and the displays how the moment a loop evaluates its control relates to the region where a write of another process by an ZXQPH0QXZ , after #ZXQPH1QXZ or at a later time becomes visible.
translations.ループの中の ZXQPH0QXZ と、ループの前に始めた ZXQPH1QXZ が: Check that ZXQPH0QXZ in a loop and ZXQPH1QXZ started before the loop show the values at the end of the time slot.
translations.ループ本体の# ZXQPH0QXZ と# ZXQPH1QXZ の遅延制御が、制御: Check that a delay control of #ZXQPH0QXZ or #ZXQPH1QXZ in the loop body changes when the control is read and which value it sees.
translations.リテラルの字句（x・zの左詰め、?、下線、unbased unsized、符号、: Check that the text of a literal (x or z padding on the left, a question mark, underscores, unbased unsized forms, signs, negation, string escapes) decides the displayed width and the character of each digit.
translations.マクロで運んだリテラルも同じ値で表示され、文字列リテラルに展開されたマクロは書式: Check that a literal carried by a macro shows the same value, and that a macro expanding to a string literal is taken as format text.
translations.型のない ZXQPH0QXZ がリテラルの幅と符号を保ち、文字列で初期化した場合: Check that an untyped ZXQPH0QXZ keeps the width and sign of the literal, and shows as an integer also when a string initializes it.
translations.連結がリテラルを符号なしにし、%dの桁数と符号の表示が変わることを確かめる。: Check that a concatenation makes the literal unsigned, which changes the %d width and the shown sign.
translations.型なし・範囲・符号付き範囲・signedだけ・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQP: Override an untyped, ranged, signed ranged, signed-only, ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ or packed-structure parameter by its declaration, #() or ZXQPH2QXZ .
translations.最終的な値・幅・符号と、 ZXQPH0QXZ が#()より優先して型も決めること: Check the final value, width and sign, and that ZXQPH0QXZ wins over #() and also decides the type.
translations.x・zを含む値に ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2Q: Apply ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ and ZXQPH4QXZ to values with x or z, and judge them in immediate, #ZXQPH5QXZ and final assertions.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の途中の値による遅延アサーションの報告の取消しと、クロックの: Check that a value in between flushes the report of a deferred assertion in ZXQPH0QXZ , and what an ZXQPH1QXZ at a rising clock does.
translations.符号付き・無サイズ・unbased unsized・実数・文字列のリテラルを、型: Pass signed, unsized, unbased unsized, real and string literals to formals of other types, as defaults and as return values.
translations.代入と同じ変換と、エスケープした識別子の名前による結合を確かめる。: Check the conversion that an assignment makes, and binding by escaped names.
translations.型も範囲もない値パラメータは最終的な上書きの値の型と範囲になり、範囲だけは符号な: A value parameter without a type or range takes the type and range of the final override value; a range alone is unsigned, signed alone keeps the range of the value, and a type with a range converts to both.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ は同じインスタンスの#()より優先し、そのときも型と範囲は: ZXQPH0QXZ wins over #() of the same instance, and the type and range then also come from the ZXQPH1QXZ value.
translations.上書きの式は、それ自身の幅で評価してから変換しても、パラメータの幅で評価しても同: Only override expressions that give the same value at their own width and at the width of the parameter are used.
translations.無サイズの値は範囲が処理系依存なので使わない。: Unsized values are not used, because their range is implementation-dependent.
translations.vの初期値は ZXQPH0QXZ 、途中の値は ZXQPH1QXZ で、どちらも: v starts at ZXQPH0QXZ and passes through ZXQPH1QXZ , and neither equals an observed value.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2QXZ は ZXQP: ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ and ZXQPH2QXZ count only the bits that are ZXQPH3QXZ , ZXQPH4QXZ counts only the bits equal to the given values, and x and z bits are not counted.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ はxかzのビットがあれば ZXQPH1QXZ になる。: ZXQPH0QXZ is ZXQPH1QXZ when a bit is x or z.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ は時刻 ZXQPH1QXZ に一度評価する。: ZXQPH0QXZ evaluates once at time ZXQPH1QXZ .
translations.途中の値で再評価すると、遅延アサーションの報告は取り消され、即時アサーションの報: A reevaluation for a value in between flushes the report of a deferred assertion, while the report of an immediate assertion stays.
translations.クロックの立上りと同時の ZXQPH0QXZ は、その立上りで評価する値を変えな: An ZXQPH0QXZ at a rising clock does not change the value evaluated at that edge.
translations.initialでの途中の値は評価の前に上書きされるので除外する。: A value in between in an initial procedure is overwritten before the evaluation, so it is left out.
translations.並行アサーションは ZXQPH0QXZ の実装を待つので、このモデルに含めない。: Concurrent assertions wait for ZXQPH0QXZ to implement them, so they are not in this model.
translations.実引数・既定の引数・戻り値はどれも代入と同じ規則で仮引数の型へ変換する。: An actual argument, a default argument and a return value are each converted to the type of the formal by the rules of an assignment.
translations.実数は最も近い整数に丸め、 ZXQPH0QXZ は ZXQPH1QXZ から離れ: A real rounds to the nearest integer, and ZXQPH0QXZ rounds away from ZXQPH1QXZ .
translations.文字列リテラルは ZXQPH0QXZ ビットの文字を並べた符号なしの整数である。: A string literal is an unsigned integer whose characters take ZXQPH0QXZ bits each.
translations.string型の仮引数には文字列リテラルだけを、real型にはunbased u: Only the string literal goes to a string formal, and no unbased unsized literal goes to a real formal.
translations.エスケープした識別子はtask・function・仮引数の名前に使い、空白で終え: Escaped identifiers name the task, the function and the formal, and end at white space.
translations.上書きの値の式（単項マイナス・連結・加算）が、宣言の型と範囲へ変換されて、パラメ: Check that an override expression (unary minus, concatenation, addition), converted to the declared type and range, decides the value, width and sign of the parameter.
translations.型なし・範囲・符号付き範囲・signedだけ・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQP: Check that the type and range of an untyped, ranged, signed ranged, signed-only, ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ value parameter come from the declaration and the final override value.
translations.パック構造体のパラメータを上書きし、符号付きのメンバと符号なしのメンバを読む。: Override a packed-structure parameter, and read its signed and unsigned members.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2QXZ ・ ZXQP: Check by the result of assertions that ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ and ZXQPH4QXZ count only the ZXQPH5QXZ and ZXQPH6QXZ bits of values with x or z.
translations.遅延アサーションの報告がObserved領域とPostponed領域で出て、同じ: Check that deferred assertions report in the observed and postponed regions, and that a reevaluation in the same time slot flushes the report.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ の時刻 ZXQPH1QXZ の評価と、途中の値による再実行が: Check that the evaluation of ZXQPH0QXZ at time ZXQPH1QXZ and a rerun for a value in between change the number of assertion reports.
translations.リテラルの字句（無サイズ・unbased unsized・符号付き・実数・文字列: Check that the form of a literal (unsized, unbased unsized, signed, real, string) and escaped identifiers decide the conversion to a formal, a default or a return value, and binding by name.
translations.unbased unsizedは整数型の仮引数の幅いっぱいに広がり、二値の型では: An unbased unsized literal fills the whole width of an integral formal, and a two-state type turns x into ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.二値の型・real・stringの仮引数へ渡すと、xが ZXQPH0QXZ にな: Check that passing to a two-state, real or string formal turns x into ZXQPH0QXZ , rounds a real and keeps a string as characters.
translations.下向き・入れ子・インスタンス配列・生成ブロック・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・モジュー: Through a downward, nested, instance-array, generate-block, ZXQPH0QXZ , upward-by-module-name or upward-to-a-sibling hierarchical name, a process disables a named block of another instance, triggers an event, writes a value or calls a task.
translations.対象が待ち始める前後で、効果が失われるか残るかを確かめる。: Before and after the target starts to wait, check whether the effect is lost or kept.
translations.対象のプロセスは時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ か ZXQPH1QXZ に待ち始め、操: The target process starts to wait at time ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ , and the acting process acts once at time ZXQPH2QXZ .
translations.操作する側は操作の前に値を表示し、同じタイムスロットでほかのプロセスと表示の順序: The acting process prints the value before it acts, so no two processes race to print in the same time slot.
translations.実行中でないブロックのdisableは何もせず、待つプロセスのないイベントの起動: Disabling a block that is not running does nothing, and an event trigger or a value change with no process waiting is lost.
translations.wait文は待ち始めに条件が成り立っていればすぐに進む。: A wait statement goes on at once when its condition already holds as it starts.
translations.下向きの名前、インスタンス配列と生成ブロックを通る名前、 ZXQPH0QXZ 、: A downward name, a name through an instance array or a generate block, ZXQPH0QXZ , an upward name by the module name and an upward name to a sibling instance all reach the same target.
translations.トップ・子・孫・インスタンス配列・ループ生成・名前付きと名前のない生成ブロックの: In the top module, a child, a grandchild, an instance array, a loop generate block, and named and unnamed generate blocks, print %m from the module, a named block, a fork, a statement label, a loop label, a task, a function and an automatic task.
translations.サブルーチンを自分のモジュール・下向き・ ZXQPH0QXZ ・上向きから呼んで: Check that a subroutine prints the name where it is declared, whether it is called from its own module, downward, from ZXQPH0QXZ or upward.
translations.%mは表示を含むスコープの階層名を出し、サブルーチンでは呼び出し元ではなく定義の: %m prints the hierarchical name of the scope that holds the display; in a subroutine it is the name where the subroutine is declared, not that of the caller.
translations.文のラベルとforの宣言付きループのラベルは名前付きのブロックを作る。: A statement label and the label of a for loop that declares its variable make a named block.
translations.名前のない生成ブロックは、その前の生成構文を数えたgenblkの名前になる。: An unnamed generate block is named genblk with the number that counts the generate constructs up to it.
translations.外から名前のない生成ブロックの中は参照できないので、下向きと ZXQPH0QXZ: Names inside an unnamed generate block cannot be reached from outside it, so downward and ZXQPH0QXZ calls are left out there.
translations.finalには関数に書ける文だけを書けるので、taskの呼び出しとfork-jo: A final procedure holds only the statements a function may hold, so task calls and fork-join are left out there.
translations.どのテストも表示するプロセスは一つだけで、表示の順序を競わない。: Each test has only one process that prints, so no prints race.
translations.昇順・降順・オフセット・負の範囲の固定の次元、パックの次元、動的配列、キュー、空: Query fixed dimensions with ascending, descending, offset and negative ranges, a packed dimension, a dynamic array, a queue and an empty dynamic array with ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ , ZXQPH4QXZ , ZXQPH5QXZ and ZXQPH6QXZ , through the variable, the type name, dimension ZXQPH0QXZ or an element select.
translations.for・while・do-while・repeat・foreachで、左から右・: Check that for, while, do-while, repeat and foreach go from left to right, from low to high, from high to low, or by the count.
translations.要素は左の添字から ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQPH2: The elements from the left index are ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ , and the empty dynamic array has no elements.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ は固定の次元で左が右以上なら ZXQPH1QXZ 、そうでな: ZXQPH0QXZ returns ZXQPH1QXZ for a fixed dimension whose left bound is not less than its right bound, ZXQPH2QXZ for another fixed dimension, and ZXQPH3QXZ for a dynamic array or a queue.
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ は ZXQPH2QXZ で ZXQP: ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ follow from ZXQPH3QXZ and ZXQPH4QXZ through ZXQPH2QXZ , and for an empty dynamic array ZXQPH5QXZ and ZXQPH6QXZ are ZXQPH7QXZ .
translations.型の名前と ZXQPH0QXZ 番目の次元の問い合わせは固定の大きさの次元だけに: Queries of a type name and of dimension ZXQPH0QXZ are used on fixed-size dimensions only.
translations.foreachは左の添字から右へ進む。: foreach goes from the left index to the right.
translations.do-whileは空の配列でも一度実行して、ない要素のxを読む。: A do-while runs once even on an empty array and reads x from the element that does not exist.
translations.do-whileで ZXQPH0QXZ から ZXQPH1QXZ へ進む空の配列: A do-while from ZXQPH0QXZ to ZXQPH1QXZ over an empty array never ends, so it is left out.
translations.foreachが添字を左から右へ進み、do-whileが空の配列でもない要素を一: Check that foreach goes from the left index to the right, and that a do-while reads an element that does not exist once, even on an empty array.
translations.固定・パック・動的配列・キュー・空の動的配列と、型の名前・ ZXQPH0QXZ: Check the values of queries on fixed, packed, dynamic, queue and empty dynamic dimensions, through a type name, dimension ZXQPH0QXZ and an element select.
translations.名前付きのbegin・fork・文のラベルが、%mの階層名を一段深くすることを確: Check that a named begin, a named fork and a statement label add one level to the hierarchical name that %m prints.
translations.別のインスタンスのプロセスを、階層名によるdisable・イベント・値の変化・t: Stop or wake a process of another instance by a disable, an event, a value change or a task call through a hierarchical name, and check that an action before the process starts to wait is lost.
translations.階層名への即時代入とノンブロッキング代入で、同じタイムスロットに読む値と、待つプ: With a blocking and a nonblocking assignment to a hierarchical name, check the value read in the same time slot and the time the waiting process wakes.
translations.for・while・do-while・repeat・foreachの範囲を ZX: Take the range of for, while, do-while, repeat and foreach from ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ , ZXQPH4QXZ and ZXQPH5QXZ , and check the order of the indices visited.
translations.変数を宣言するforのラベルが、ループの暗黙のブロックの名前として%mに出ること: Check that the label of a for loop that declares its variable appears in %m as the name of the implicit block of the loop.
translations.task・automatic task・functionの中の%mが、呼び出し元: Check that %m in a task, an automatic task or a function prints the name where it is declared, not that of the caller.
translations.階層名で呼んだtaskが、定義したインスタンスの変数を書き、遅延を呼び出し元のプ: Check that a task called through a hierarchical name writes the variable of the instance where it is declared, and spends its delay in the calling process.
translations.階層名で指したイベントの起動が、待っているプロセスだけを起こすことを確かめる。: Check that triggering an event named through a hierarchical name wakes only the processes already waiting.
translations.%mが、子・孫・インスタンス配列・上向きと ZXQPH0QXZ の呼出しでも、表: Check that %m prints the hierarchical name of the scope that holds the display in a child, a grandchild and an instance array, and for upward and ZXQPH0QXZ calls.
translations.ループ生成・名前付きの生成ブロック・番号で名前の付く生成ブロックが、%mの階層名: Check that a loop generate block, a named generate block and a generate block named by its number appear in the hierarchical name that %m prints.
translations.無サイズ・サイズ付き・実数・時間リテラル・x・zを含む値・負の値の遅延を、文の前: Use unsized, sized, real, time-literal, x- or z-bearing and negative delays before a statement, inside blocking and nonblocking assignments, in a fork branch, in a task and in a repeat loop.
translations.精度 ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ への丸め、xとzの ZXQPH: Check rounding to a precision of ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ , a delay of ZXQPH2QXZ for x and z, and a negative value that never ends.
translations.時間単位は ZXQPH0QXZ 、精度は ZXQPH1QXZ か ZXQPH2Q: The time unit is ZXQPH0QXZ and the precision ZXQPH1QXZ or ZXQPH2QXZ ; a delay is rounded to that precision before it waits.
translations.丸めの境目の値は使わない。: No value lies on a rounding tie.
translations.値にxかzのビットを含む遅延は ZXQPH0QXZ 、負の遅延は時間変数と同じ幅: A delay with an x or z bit is ZXQPH0QXZ , and a negative delay is taken as an unsigned value as wide as a time variable.
translations.負の遅延は時刻 ZXQPH0QXZ で精度 ZXQPH1QXZ のときだけ使い、: A negative delay is used only at time ZXQPH0QXZ with a precision of ZXQPH1QXZ , leaving out cases that pass the largest time.
translations.待つ文はプロセスごとに一つで、時刻は実数で小数点以下を一桁まで表示する。: Each process has one waiting statement, and times are printed as reals with one digit after the point.
translations.packageの変数と関数を、モジュールとブロックのwildcard impor: Use a package variable and function as a loop bound through a wildcard import in the module or the block, an explicit import, or ZXQPH0QXZ ::.
translations.前後の宣言・ブロックの変数・別のpackageのimportと競わせ、 ZXQP: Let earlier and later declarations, a block variable and an import of another package compete, and check the search order of ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.名前はまず参照のあるスコープで、宣言と明示のimportを探し、なければその点よ: A name is first searched in the scope of the reference, among declarations and explicit imports, and then among wildcard imports before that point.
translations.見つからなければ外側のスコープで同じことを繰り返す。: If it is not found, the same search repeats in the outer scope.
translations.関数の呼出しは、スコープの終わりまでの宣言を探す。: A function call searches the declarations up to the end of the scope.
translations.ブロックのwildcard importは外側の宣言より先に見つかり、後のwil: A wildcard import in the block is found before an outer declaration, and a later wildcard import does not act before the reference.
translations.明示のimportと同じスコープの同名の宣言、参照で見えるようになったimpor: An explicit import with a declaration of the same name in the same scope, a declaration after a reference made an imported name visible, and a reference that two wildcard imports in one scope both supply are illegal and left out.
translations.ブロックの変数は初期化子を付けずに宣言し、文で値を入れる。: Block variables are declared without an initializer and set by a statement.
translations.モジュール・インスタンス・ポート・パラメータ・変数・task・生成ブロックの名前: Escape the names of a module, an instance, a port, a parameter, a variable, a task and a generate block, and check binding with the plain and escaped forms swapped, names with a plus sign, escaped keywords, and names ended by a space, a tab or a newline.
translations.エスケープした識別子は\\で始まり空白で終わり、\\と終わりの空白は名前に含まな: An escaped identifier starts with \ and ends with white space, and neither the \ nor the ending white space is part of the name.
translations.そのため\\abcとabcは同じ名前で、エスケープしたキーワードは利用者の名前に: So \abc and abc are the same name, and an escaped keyword is a user-defined name.
translations.階層名ではエスケープした名前の後に空白を置いてからピリオドを続ける。: In a hierarchical name, an escaped name is followed by white space and then the period.
translations.名前の読み違いが値に出るように、+を含む名前には、+の前の部分と同じ名前の宣言を: So that a misread name shows in the values, a name with a plus sign comes with another declaration named like its part before the plus sign.
translations.平易な参照には終わりの空白がないので、空白の種類は一つだけにする。: A plain reference has no ending white space, so it takes only one kind of white space.
translations.実数と時間リテラルの遅延を、時間単位で換算してから精度 ZXQPH0QXZ か: Check that real and time-literal delays are converted to the time unit and then rounded to a precision of ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ .
translations.無サイズ・サイズ付き・実数・時間リテラル・x・zを含む値・負の値の遅延の字句が、: Check that the text of an unsized, sized, real, time-literal, x- or z-bearing or negative delay decides how long it waits.
translations.エスケープしたtaskの名前を、インスタンスを通して呼ぶ。: Call a task with an escaped name through the instance.
translations.モジュール・インスタンス・ポート・パラメータ・変数・生成ブロックのエスケープした: Check that escaped names of a module, an instance, a port, a parameter, a variable and a generate block bind in the hierarchy as the same names as their plain forms.
translations.エスケープした生成ブロックの名前を、階層名で読む。: Read through a generate block with an escaped name in a hierarchical name.
translations.即時代入とノンブロッキング代入の中の遅延が、右辺を先に評価して代入だけを遅らせる: Check that a delay inside a blocking or a nonblocking assignment evaluates the right-hand side first and delays only the assignment.
translations.for・while・repeat・do-whileの範囲に使う名前が、 ZXQP: Check that a name used as the bound of for, while, repeat and do-while binds to a package, a declaration or another import by the search order of ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.関数の呼出しがスコープの終わりまでの宣言を探し、後のwildcard impor: Check that a function call searches the declarations up to the end of the scope and does not use a later wildcard import.
translations.子モジュールと、そのfor・if・caseの生成ブロックでクラスを宣言し、メソッ: Declare a class in a child module and in its for, if and case generate blocks, and read the parameter, local parameter, variable and function of the declaring scope from a method.
translations.静的メソッド・派生クラス・階層名での呼出し、クラスの静的メンバーと外側の同じ名前: Check static methods, derived classes and calls through hierarchical names, and how static members of the class and the same names outside relate.
translations.クラスは子moduleの中か、そのgenerateブロック（for・if・cas: The class is declared in a child module or in one of its generate blocks (for, if, case), and the child module has two instances with different parameter values.
translations.メソッドは、クラスを宣言したスコープのパラメータ・局所パラメータ・変数・関数を名: The method reads by name a parameter, a local parameter, a variable or a function of the scope that declares the class.
translations.変数は二回の読み出しの間に増やし、メソッドが呼出し時の値を読むことを確かめる。: The variable is increased between two reads, which shows that the method reads the value at the call.
translations.同じ名前を、クラスの静的メンバーか、外側のスコープ（topと、generateブ: Rows also declare the same name as a static member of the class, or in the outer scopes (the top module and the module around a generate block).
translations.静的メソッドはクラススコープで呼ぶので、宣言したスコープの中からだけ呼ぶ。: A static method is called through the class scope, so it is called only from inside the declaring scope.
translations.読み出しの時刻はインスタンスごとにずらす。: Each instance reads at its own time.
translations.?・z・xの桁を持つ二進・八進・十六進・十進のリテラルを、先頭の桁と幅を変えてc: Write binary, octal, hexadecimal and decimal literals with ?, z or x digits as case items, with varied leftmost digit and width, and check how the digits pad and compare in case, casez, casex and case inside.
translations.選択式は ZXQPH0QXZ [ ZXQPH1QXZ ]とし、?・z・xのどれか: The selector is ZXQPH0QXZ [ ZXQPH1QXZ ], checked against one item with one kind of ?, z or x digit and a default.
translations.項目は二進・八進・十六進・十進のリテラルで、先頭の桁が不定値か既知の値か、幅が選: The item is a binary, octal, hexadecimal or decimal literal, led by the wildcard digit or a known digit, narrower than, as wide as or wider than the selector, or unsized.
translations.先頭が不定値なら、その値でリテラルの幅まで埋まる。: A literal led by the wildcard digit is padded with that value to its size.
translations.その後でcaseが全体を最も広い式の幅へ広げ、上のビットはゼロになる。: The case then extends everything to the widest expression, and the upper bits are zero.
translations.一つのプログラムで、不定値の位置を既知の値で埋めた値・既知の位置を一つ反転した値: One program compares in turn a value with the wildcard positions filled with known bits, one with a known bit flipped, ones with a known bit made z or x, and the four-state bits of the item itself.
translations.十進はx・z・?を一桁だけ書けるので先頭は不定値だけにする。: A decimal number may hold only one x, z or ? digit, so it is always led by the wildcard.
translations.十六進の二桁は狭い幅に入らないので除外する。: Two hexadecimal digits do not fit the narrow width, so those rows are left out.
translations.入れ子の構造体と配列を持つ構造体へ、位置・メンバー名・複製・default・型キ: Give values to a structure with a nested structure and an array by position, member name, replication, default and type keys.
translations.各メンバーの型への変換と、キーの優先順位を、初期値・代入・型付きの式・ ZXQP: Check the conversion to each member type and the precedence of the keys in an initializer, an assignment, a typed expression and a ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.構造体は、 ZXQPH0QXZ のメンバーa、 ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZXQP: The structure has a member a of ZXQPH0QXZ , a structure n with ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ , ZXQPH3QXZ and ZXQPH4QXZ members, and an unpacked array q of ZXQPH5QXZ .
translations.値を位置・メンバー名・複製・default・型キーで与え、型キーは ZXQPH0: Values are given by position, member name, replication, default and type keys, and the type keys are only ZXQPH0QXZ , ZXQPH1QXZ , ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ .
translations.ZXQPH0QXZ と ZXQPH1QXZ は一致する型ではないので、 ZXQP: ZXQPH0QXZ and ZXQPH1QXZ are not matching types, so a ZXQPH2QXZ key does not reach a ZXQPH3QXZ member.
translations.defaultがあれば、型キーとdefaultは入れ子の構造体と配列へ降りて当て: With a default, the type keys and the default go down into the nested structure and array.
translations.defaultがないときに降りるかは読み方が分かれるので、その形では型キーを入れ: Whether they go down without a default is read in two ways, so in that form the type keys are written in the nested patterns themselves.
translations.メンバー名が型キーより、型キーがdefaultより優先し、同じ型キーは最後の値を: A member name wins over a type key, a type key over default, and a type key given twice uses its last value.
translations.値は各メンバーへの代入として変換し、二値の型ではxをゼロにする。: A value is converted as an assignment to each member, and a two-state type turns x into zero.
translations.すべての組合せは合法で、宣言の初期値・手続きの代入・型付きのパターン式・ ZXQ: Every combination is legal, and the same value is carried by a declaration initializer, a procedural assignment, a typed pattern expression and a ZXQPH0QXZ .
translations.構造体リテラルの位置・メンバー名・複製・default・型キーが、入れ子の構造体: Check that the positions, member names, replication, default and type keys of a structure literal set each member of the nested structure and array through its type.
translations.?・z・xの桁を持つリテラルの埋め方と、case・casez・casex・cas: Check together how a literal with ?, z or x digits pads and how case, casez, casex and case inside compare it.
translations.パラメータの異なる二つのインスタンスで宣言したクラスのメソッドが、宣言したモジュ: Check that the method of a class declared in two instances with different parameters reads the names of the declaring module, with the same binding through hierarchical names.

translations.ZXQPH0QXZ : ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ に ZXQP: ZXQPH0QXZ: At ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ, ZXQPH3QXZ processes each give violations: ZXQPH4QXZ (lines ZXQPH5QXZ to ZXQPH6QXZ) and ZXQPH7QXZ (line ZXQPH8QXZ) resume from @(go)/wait (go) after ZXQPH9QXZ at the same time and reach a flush point, while ZXQPH10QXZ (line ZXQPH11QXZ, suspended by # ZXQPH12QXZ) and ZXQPH13QXZ (line ZXQPH14QXZ, not suspended) do not reach a flush point.

translations.違反報告をその時実行中のプロセスのキューではなく共通のキューに積む実装では、 Z: In an implementation that puts violation reports in a common queue instead of the queue of the process executing at that time, the flush on the resumption of ZXQPH0QXZ or ZXQPH1QXZ also discards the reports of ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ, so lines ZXQPH4QXZ and ZXQPH5QXZ are no longer named and the regex does not match.

translations.ZXQPH0QXZ : ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ に対し項目は: ZXQPH0QXZ: For ZXQPH1QXZ = ZXQPH2QXZ, the items are variables (ZXQPH3QXZ = ZXQPH4QXZ, ZXQPH5QXZ = ZXQPH6QXZ, ZXQPH7QXZ = ZXQPH8QXZ, ZXQPH9QXZ = ZXQPH10QXZ), and none of them matches.
translations.default なしの unique case（ ZXQPH0QXZ 行）・pr: For the unique case (line ZXQPH0QXZ), priority case (line ZXQPH1QXZ), priority casez (line ZXQPH2QXZ) and unique casex (line ZXQPH3QXZ) without a default, the regex requires reports naming them, and stdout shows ZXQPH4QXZ, as nothing is executed.
translations.default 付きの unique case（ ZXQPH0QXZ 行）・pr: The unique case (line ZXQPH0QXZ) and priority case (line ZXQPH1QXZ) with a default execute the default (ZXQPH2QXZ), and the regex rejects reports naming them.
translations.一致する項目がある unique case（ ZXQPH0QXZ 行、 ZXQP: The unique case with a matching item (line ZXQPH0QXZ, ZXQPH1QXZ) outputs ZXQPH2QXZ, and reports naming it are rejected.
translations.一致なしを報告しない実装は ZXQPH0QXZ ・ ZXQPH1QXZ ・ ZX: An implementation that does not report a no-match does not name lines ZXQPH0QXZ, ZXQPH1QXZ, ZXQPH2QXZ and ZXQPH3QXZ and does not match the regex.
